name: aurelia-retro-nasa
artStyle: Sleek polished retro sci-fi illustration in the manner of 1970s NASA concept art and Syd Mead, with a Moebius paperback palette: clean painted shapes with smooth two-to-three step soft gradient shading, never pixel art and never photographic texture. Human hardware is rounded pressure-hull forms, domes, capsules and chamfered boxes in warm cream hull paint with sodium-amber trim, recessed panel lines and small glowing amber windows; alien Aurelia is violet, ochre and iridescent nacre crystal shards with faceted planes; fauna are glassy segmented chitin insects with pale lime lens eyes. Every object carries a hard, thick, even dark ink outline. Proportions are chunky and toy-readable: one clear silhouette mass per object, detail only as panel lines, rivets and window rows, never noise. Consistent 3/4 top-down orthographic game camera.
camera: Frontal 3/4 top-down orthographic game camera looking straight north: the object shows its top plus a front face about 30% of its height, no isometric diagonal rotation, no perspective convergence, constant camera distance and scale across every asset.
lighting: Low warm dusk key light from the upper left, cool violet ambient in the shadows, small amber practical glows from windows and lamps; soft gradient form shading only, no cast shadow, no ground contact shading, no ground plane.
outline: Hard, thick, even 3-4 px near-black warm ink outline (#1a1418) around every outer silhouette at a 256 px cell, thinner ink lines for panel seams and internal overlaps; never a coloured or light outline.

plan.temperature: Colony and player are warm: cream hull, sodium amber, brass. Aurelia is cool: violet, dusk purple, nacre. Threat is rust (#c8553d) and oxblood outlines baked at runtime, never painted into sprites; fauna bodies stay desaturated glass-violet with pale lime eyes. Reward is brass/gold. Rime biome owns cold frost blue (#7d93b8).
saturationHierarchy: amber window glow and reward brass
fauna lime lens eyes and threat rust
cream hull and ochre ground neutrals

focal.primary: the glowing amber windows / emitter of a building, or the single glyph of an icon
focal.secondary: the silhouette-defining hardware: drill mast, turret barrels, dome cap, crystal spire
focal.rest: large smooth cream hull panels and the dark ochre ground

materials.hull: enamel-painted pressure hull, smooth soft gradient, crisp inked panel seams, a few rivets, faint wear on edges
materials.metal: brushed machine steel in warm grey, one soft specular band, dark ink seams
materials.glass: amber-lit window glass that glows from inside with a soft bloom
materials.crystal: faceted iridescent nacre-violet shards with flat planes and one pale edge highlight
materials.chitin: translucent glassy insect shell, segmented plates, a pale rim light, lens-like glowing eyes
materials.rock: rust-dark ore rock, cracked angular planes, matte, two value steps
materials.energy: amber or teal plasma with a bright near-white core and a soft additive fringe
